LEVEL Finance, a project on BNB, was hacked and lost $1 million. The hackers created an unverified contract 7 days before the attack, used a delegate function to extract LVL tokens in 15,000 increments, converted 214,000 LVL tokens into 3,345 BNB and transferred them to Tornado Cash.

On May 1, 2023, Level Finance on BNB Chain lost over $1M in LVL tokens after an attacker exploited a bug in the referral reward contract. The attack allowed unlimited repeated reward claims in the same rewards period (epoch), draining the referral pool. The LevelReferralControllerV2 contract allowed users to claim referral rewards for the same epoch multiple times because claimMultiple() did not check for duplicate epochs. This enabled repeated reward payouts far exceeding the actual earned amount.
